digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to single core push entrypoints with no inline CAS/fetch/merge/retry loops
Reconciler workflow must perform strict synchronous commit-and-push with preserved bot identity and exact commit subject, remaining red on exhausted delivery failure
Canary workflow must perform strict synchronous push-only action via rebar._store.push, remaining red on exhausted delivery failure
Core owns retry and CAS recovery; Python library and MCP retain best-effort defaults; raw-git exemption for reconciler must be removed
Workflow acceptance verified by executable real-git smoke tests confirming successful delivery, rejected-push red failure, and preserved commit identity under sync.push=off override
Stale synthetic test rationale referencing ticket 4c4f CAS-loop behavior must be replaced with generic reviewed-workflow wording
